connection.title: Connections
connection.empty: No saved connection yet. Fill in the form to add one.
connection.name: Name
connection.passwordSaved: Saved in the keychain (leave empty to keep)
connection.savePassword: Save passwords in the system keychain
connection.trustHostKey: I checked this fingerprint, trust it and retry
connection.confirmDelete: Delete the connection “{name}” and its saved passwords?
connection.sshCertPlaceholder: Optional: <key>-cert.pub is used when it exists

tlsHelp.disabled: Data travels in clear text. Only for local servers.
tlsHelp.preferred: Encrypts when the server supports it, without checking its certificate.
tlsHelp.required: Always encrypts; fails if the server has no TLS. The certificate is not checked.
tlsHelp.verify-ca: Encrypts and checks that the certificate is signed by a trusted CA.
tlsHelp.verify-identity: Most secure: also checks that the certificate matches the host name.

session.notMariadb: This server is not MariaDB. Basic features work; MariaDB-specific features are hidden.
session.pickObject: Pick a table or another object in the tree to open it.

errors.DB_ACCESS_DENIED: Access denied: check the user name and password.
errors.DB_NO_PRIVILEGE: Access denied: this account lacks the privilege for this action.
errors.DB_UNKNOWN_DATABASE: The default database does not exist.
errors.DB_UNREACHABLE: Cannot reach the server: check the host, port and firewall.
errors.DB_TIMEOUT: The server did not answer in time.
errors.TLS: Secure connection failed: the server certificate could not be verified.
errors.TLS_NOT_SUPPORTED: The server does not support TLS. Choose “Preferred” or “Off”.
errors.AUTH_PLUGIN: This account uses an authentication method Otaria does not support yet.
errors.KEYCHAIN: Could not access the system keychain.
errors.PROFILES_CORRUPT: The saved connections file is damaged.
errors.SSH_TIMEOUT: The SSH server did not answer in time.
errors.SSH_HOST_UNKNOWN: Unknown SSH server. Compare this fingerprint with the server's before trusting it.
errors.SSH_HOST_CHANGED: Warning: the SSH server's key changed since last time. This can be an attack. Trust it only if the server was reinstalled.
errors.SSH_AUTH: SSH login refused: check the user, password or key.
errors.SSH_KEY: Cannot read the SSH private key (wrong path or passphrase?).
errors.NO_PRIMARY_KEY: This table has no primary key, so its rows cannot be edited.
errors.ROW_CONFLICT: A row was changed or deleted by someone else meanwhile. Nothing was saved; reload and try again.
errors.NO_DDL: The definition is not available (missing privilege?).
errors.CONFIRM_RISKY: Confirmation required for a destructive statement.
errors.ALTER_ALGORITHM: The server cannot make this change that way.
errors.PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE: This plugin cannot be installed: it is not listed as available on this server.
errors.EXPORT_FORMAT: This format cannot export a whole database.
errors.EXPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows for an Excel sheet. Use CSV or JSON.
errors.IMPORT_STATEMENT: The import stopped at a failing statement. The statements before it were applied.
errors.FILE_NOT_UTF8: The file is not UTF-8 text.
errors.CSV_DELIMITER: The delimiter must be one character.
errors.CSV_PARSE: The CSV file could not be read.
errors.IMPORT_ROWS: The server refused rows of the file. Nothing was imported.
errors.COPY_SAME: Pick another database than the source.
errors.VARIABLE_VALUE: Not a valid value for this variable.
errors.ANALYZE_SELECT_ONLY: Analyze works on one SELECT statement: put the cursor in it or select it.
errors.LAST_HISTORY_PARTITION: A system-versioned table keeps at least one history partition: this one cannot be dropped.
errors.INVALID_VECTOR: Not a valid vector: write it as [0.1, 0.2, …].
errors.VECTOR_DIMENSIONS: The vector does not have the column's number of dimensions.
errors.NO_SINGLE_KEY: Searching by row needs a primary key on a single column.
errors.BINLOG_OFF: Binary logging is off on this server (log_bin).
errors.BINLOG_TOOL_MISSING: mariadb-binlog was not found. Install the MariaDB client (Homebrew: brew install mariadb; Linux: mariadb-client package; Windows: MariaDB installer).
errors.BINLOG_POSITION: This position is past the end of the file.
errors.SSH_CERT: Cannot read the SSH certificate (OpenSSH -cert.pub file).

palette.title: Find an object
palette.placeholder: Find a table, view, routine… (schema.name works too)
palette.hint: {n} objects in all databases. Type part of a name; ↑ ↓ to move, Enter to open.

object.closeDirty: Close this tab? Unsaved changes will be lost.
object.leaveDirty: Switch view? Unsaved changes will be lost.
object.truncateText: Every row is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
object.dropText: The object and everything in it are deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

grid.cutHint: Long value cut at 1024 characters: open it with the JSON button to read or edit it whole.
grid.noKeyCellSql: No primary key: the row is found by its other values (first match).
grid.previewHint: These statements run in one transaction: if one fails, nothing is changed.

editor.runHint: Run everything, or the selection (⌘/Ctrl+Enter, F9)
editor.runCurrentHint: Run the statement under the cursor (⌘/Ctrl+Shift+Enter)
editor.cappedStopped: display capped, the rest was not read (the server was stopped)
editor.countHint: Count every row of this read: it runs again on the server and can take a while.
editor.hint: Type SQL, then Run. Several statements give several results; use DELIMITER for routine bodies.
editor.confirmText: These statements modify or delete data or objects. Run them anyway?
editor.analyzeHint: Run the SELECT under the cursor (or the selection) with ANALYZE FORMAT=JSON: real times and rows next to estimates. The query really runs.

versioned.asOfHint: Show the table as it was at this moment (your local time). Past data is read-only.
versioned.rowHistoryHint: Every version of the selected row

sequence.cacheHint: Values already cached by the server are handed out before this one.
sequence.name: Name
sequence.restartPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current value
sequence.setvalOk: Done: this value is handed out next.
sequence.setvalIgnored: Ignored: SETVAL never goes backwards. Use “Restart with” instead.
sequence.asDefaultHint: Paste this into a column definition so new rows take the next value.
sequence.ddlHint: Once it has finished, this statement cannot be rolled back.

designer.algo_instant: Tried instantly first (ALGORITHM=INSTANT): the server refuses rather than rebuild the table.
designer.algo_online: Online (ALGORITHM=INPLACE, LOCK=NONE): the table may be rebuilt but stays readable and writable.
designer.algo_default: Server's choice: the table may be copied and writes blocked meanwhile.
designer.ignoredHint: Kept up to date but not used by the optimizer: a safe way to test dropping an index. Switched without rebuilding.
designer.versionedHint: WITH SYSTEM VERSIONING: every change keeps the previous row
designer.unversionedHint: WITHOUT SYSTEM VERSIONING: changing only this column adds no history row
designer.periodsNeedDates: A period needs two DATE, DATETIME or TIMESTAMP columns.
designer.partitionsHint: PARTITION BY clause, as SQL. Empty = not partitioned; clearing it runs REMOVE PARTITIONING (the rows stay).

plugins.hint: Only plugins whose library is already on the server can be installed. Others need a package installed on the server itself.
plugins.name: Name
plugins.installHint: The plugin stays installed after a server restart. Requires the INSERT privilege on mysql.plugin.
plugins.notStable: This plugin is not stable (maturity: {maturity}). The server may refuse it depending on plugin_maturity.

engines.hint: Storage engines of the server. MyRocks, Spider, CONNECT and ColumnStore appear here once installed (Plugins tab).
engines.name: Engine

replication.noChannels: This server replicates from no source.
replication.noGalera: This server is not a Galera node (wsrep_on is OFF).
replication.flowPausedHint: Share of time replication was paused because a node could not keep up, since the last FLUSH STATUS.
replication.queueHint: Average queue lengths: a growing receive queue means this node applies write-sets slower than the cluster sends them.
replication.noMembership: Node names need the SUPER privilege and the wsrep_info plugin: only the addresses (wsrep_incoming_addresses) are shown.
replication.skipHint: Skip the failing event and restart the SQL thread
replication.skipWarning: Skipped events are never applied on this replica: its data may then differ from the source.
replication.changeHint: Set up a replication channel (CHANGE MASTER TO), with a preview.
replication.changeNote: The password is not shown here and is not kept by the app. Start the channel afterwards.

binlog.hint: Annotate_rows events show the statement behind the row changes.
binlog.undoHint: Generates the undo SQL of the transactions holding the selected events (from Gtid to Xid) with mariadb-binlog --flashback, and opens it in the SQL editor without running it. Only row changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) are reversed, and only with binlog_row_image = FULL.
binlog.undoHeader: Undo of events {start} to {stop} in {file} (mariadb-binlog --flashback). Read it before running it: the BINLOG statements need the BINLOG REPLAY privilege.
binlog.jumpHint: Read from this byte position. A position inside an event starts at that event.
binlog.purge: Delete the files before this one
binlog.purgeWarning: Files deleted from the server for good: {n}. A replica that has not read them yet can no longer catch up.

vector.none: This table has no VECTOR column.
vector.mHint: M: neighbours per node in the index graph (3–200). Higher = better recall, bigger index.
vector.noIndex: No vector index: searches read the whole table. Add one in Structure.
vector.indexUnused: The index uses the {distance} distance: with this one the whole table is read.
vector.fullScan: Without a vector index the whole table is read.
vector.needSingleKey: Needs a primary key on a single column.

processes.killQueryHint: Stops the running statement; the connection stays open. A transaction in progress is rolled back up to that statement.
processes.killConnectionHint: Closes the connection; its open transaction is rolled back.
processes.planLoading: Waiting for the server… it answers when the query reaches a checkpoint, which can take a few seconds.
processes.ownHint: One of Otaria's own connections (this list or an editor tab)
processes.ownWarning: This is one of Otaria's own connections: stopping it interrupts what this app is doing, and an editor tab loses its session variables.

variables.hint: SET GLOBAL applies to new connections and is lost when the server restarts, unless it is also written in the configuration file.
variables.name: Name

users.pick: Pick an account, or create a user or a role.
users.dropConfirm: Type {name} to confirm. Its privileges are deleted with it; objects it created stay.
users.hostHint: % = any host, localhost = this machine only, 10.0.% = a network.
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password
users.applyHint: Statements run one after the other; each takes effect at once (no rollback).
users.privilegesHint: Tick or untick privileges, then review the GRANT and REVOKE statements.
users.requireSpecifiedHint: Set in SQL; kept as it is.
users.requireHint: Refuses logins without TLS, or without a valid client certificate.
users.adminOptionHint: WITH ADMIN OPTION: this account may grant the role to others

transfer.withDrop: Add DROP … IF EXISTS before each CREATE
transfer.nullAsN: Write NULL as \N (else NULL and an empty text look the same)
transfer.sqlHint: The script names no database: it can be loaded into any database.
transfer.importHint: Statements run one after the other in {schema}. The first error stops the import; the statements before it stay applied.
transfer.copyHint: Created if it does not exist. Pick another connection from the open tabs, or another database of this one.
transfer.csvHint: All rows go in one transaction: one bad row and nothing is imported.

diagram.title: ER diagram of {schema}
diagram.neighbors: Add tables linked by a foreign key
diagram.hint: Mermaid text: GitHub, GitLab, Notion and Obsidian render it as is.

compare.title: Compare into {schema}
compare.hint: Tables, sequences, views, routines, triggers and events. Sequences change through ALTER SEQUENCE and keep their current value. The script turns this database into the source; nothing runs until you run it in the editor. DROP lines are commented out. Without the TRIGGER and EVENT privileges the server hides triggers and events.

json.openHint: View or edit the focused cell as JSON
json.title: JSON · {column}
json.lossy: This document has numbers JavaScript cannot keep exactly (big integers, trailing zeros): it is shown and edited as text only, and saved as typed.
json.tableHint: Open a JSON_TABLE query over this array in a new editor

plan.offHint: Estimate off by 10× or more: statistics may be stale (ANALYZE TABLE).

versioning.off: This table keeps no history. Turn versioning on to keep every past version of each row and read the table as of any moment.
versioning.purgeHint: Deletes the versions that ended before this moment (your local time). Current rows are never touched.
versioning.otherPartitioning: This table is partitioned another way (RANGE, HASH…): SYSTEM_TIME partitions are not offered.
versioning.dropPartition: Delete this partition and the history it holds
versioning.noPartitions: History and current rows share one partition.
versioning.autoHint: AUTO (MariaDB 10.9+): a new history partition is added when the interval passes or the limit is reached.
versioning.compareNoKey: Comparing needs a primary key to match rows.
versioning.diffTruncated: only the first 10,000 rows of each side were compared
versioning.diffShown: Only the first 1,000 differences are shown.
versioning.appPeriodsHint: A period links two date columns (validity from, to). UPDATE and DELETE … FOR PORTION OF then change only part of a row's validity.
versioning.needDates: Add two DATE, DATETIME or TIMESTAMP columns to the table to define a period.
versioning.previewHint: Table changes take effect at once and cannot be rolled back. Statements run in order and stop at the first error.
versioning.destructiveHint: This deletes history for good. It cannot be undone.
versioning.portionHint: FOR PORTION OF splits the rows that overlap the range at its bounds and changes only the part inside. The primary key must include (period WITHOUT OVERLAPS), otherwise the split fails with a duplicate key.

update.title: Updates
update.restartWarning: Otaria restarts after the install: open connections are closed and unsaved queries are lost.

database.title: New database
database.name: Name
database.preview: Type a name to see the SQL.
database.dropConfirm: Drop the database {name} with all its tables, views, routines and data? This cannot be undone.
database.alterHint: Only the defaults for new tables change; existing tables and columns keep their character set.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.refresh: Reload the grid, or the tree
shortcuts.runCurrent: Run the statement under the cursor
